description: This file defines the Header component for the documentation quality dashboard frontend, including various icon components, UI controls for project selection, documentation type filtering, refresh functionality, and status display.

methods.name: LayoutIcon
methods.description: A React component that renders a SVG icon representing a layout grid.

methods.name: FolderIcon
methods.description: A React component that renders a SVG icon representing a folder.

methods.name: FileTextIcon
methods.description: A React component that renders a SVG icon representing a document with text.

methods.name: RefreshIcon
methods.description: A React component that renders a SVG icon representing refresh action.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: Main React component that provides a header bar with project, documentation type selectors, refresh button, and status indicator.
